nodes.label: OKF Entry Format Design
nodes.rationale: Uses YAML frontmatter with line-anchored delimiter parsing to prevent corruption when entry titles/bodies contain --- characters. Entry types: note, skill, project, experience, organization, person, source.

nodes.label: OpenAI Structured Outputs Extraction
nodes.rationale: Uses client.responses.parse with Pydantic models for deterministic structured extraction. Requires openai>=1.66. FakeStructuredExtractor enables tests and keyless demo mode.

nodes.label: User-Owned Editable Prompts
nodes.rationale: Prompts are markdown files at repo root (prompts/*.md), hot-read on every extraction request. No restart needed after edits. Exposed via REST API and admin-gated UI panel.

nodes.label: Two-Minute Duration Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Enforced client-side (MediaRecorder auto-stop at 120s) and server-side (PyAV probes container duration, rejects >120s with HTTP 422 before transcription). Defense in depth.

nodes.label: E2E-Only Testing Philosophy
nodes.rationale: No unit tests. Module tasks get runnable smoke-verification commands. Correctness proven by API-level pipeline tests (real SAPI speech, real whisper, real store) and Playwright browser tests (fake microphone). GitHub mocked with respx for determinism.

nodes.label: Design-Led Frontend Approach
nodes.rationale: Frontend uses frontend-design skill for visual direction, then impeccable skill for polish. ID contract keeps Playwright tests decoupled from visual iteration. Vanilla ES modules, no build step.

nodes.label: faster-whisper
nodes.rationale: Local speech-to-text transcription engine. Used with VAD filter. Model size configurable (large-v3 prod, tiny for tests).

nodes.label: OpenAI API (Structured Outputs)
nodes.rationale: Uses responses.parse endpoint with Pydantic schema for structured extraction of professional facts from transcripts and CVs.

nodes.label: SQLite FTS5 Search
nodes.rationale: Vectorless full-text retrieval following OpenKB philosophy. Entries indexed by slug, title, body, and tags.

nodes.label: Supabase Authentication
nodes.rationale: Per-user isolated KB at ./kb-data/{user_id}/. Email provider authentication via Supabase Dashboard.
